item.title: Texas Governor-elect plans to reverse CAIR terrorist designation
item.description: Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa says she will reverse the state's terrorist designation of CAIR, challenging a measure imposed by outgoing Governor Greg Abbott.

item.title: Danny Wolf scores 14 points, grabs six rebounds in Brooklyn's loss to Memphis
item.description:
The Brooklyn Nets and Israeli forward Danny Wolf suffered a 129-110 defeat to the Memphis Grizzlies in NBA action Saturday night. The loss dropped Brooklyn's record to three wins and nine losses.
Wolf finished the game with 14 points, six rebounds, and one assist.

item.title: Podcast: Sigd, Jerusalem and the dream of the Holy Temple
item.description: Temple Talk explores the Ethiopian Jewish holiday of Sigd, its connection to Jerusalem and hopes for rebuilding the Holy Temple, while welcoming the month of Kislev and revisiting Jacob and Esau’s struggle over the birthright.

item.title: Hamas confirms: Rafah Brigade commander behind October 7 massacre eliminated
item.description:
Hamas' military wing confirmed that Samir Abu Younis, the terrorist organization's Rafah Brigade commander, was eliminated overnight in a strike in the Al-Mawasi area of Khan Yunis, Reuters reported.
According to Hamas, Abu Younis was involved in planning the October 7 terrorist attack and overseeing its execution.

item.title: Eisenkot to offer Netanyahu unity government without rotation agreement
item.description: Yashar chairman Gadi Eisenkot plans to invite Likud into a unity government under his leadership, potentially offering Netanyahu a special diplomatic role. The Religious Zionist Party will also be approached.

item.title: Off-duty officer shoots driver who endangered pedestrians in Acre
item.description: An off-duty Border Police officer opens fire on a driver who endangered pedestrians and the officer himself in Acre. Driver seriously injured.

item.title: Podcast: We simply cannot afford another election
item.description: Jay Shapiro urges Netanyahu, Bennett, Eisenkot and Liberman to form a unity government, arguing that personal rivalries outweigh ideological differences.

item.title: Watch: SpaceX makes history with first-ever Starship catch
item.description: SpaceX successfully catches its Starship spacecraft after 22 hours in orbit, marking a major breakthrough in reusable spaceflight despite a booster failure.

item.title: Hamas Rafah Brigade commander eliminated
item.description:
Defense Minister Israel Katz commented on the elimination in Gaza in a post on social media, "The IDF continues to eliminate Hamas leaders in Gaza, and another one has joined his predecessors in the depths of hell."
"The offensive policy that I am leading together with the Prime Minister and the IDF in Gaza will continue until Gaza is demilitarized and Hamas is no more," he added.

item.title: Hamas Rafah Brigade commander killed
item.description: Samir Abu Yunis, the newly appointed commander of the Rafah Brigade in Hamas's military wing, was killed in four strikes targeting a refugee tent where he was staying west of Khan Yunis.

item.title: We fed the crocodile for too long: Israel's mission today
item.description: Today Jacob must increase his voice and must don the gloves of Esau to eliminate through absolute strength and deterrence every vestige of terror in its midst.

item.title: Senior BBC executive revealed to have anti-Israel leanings
item.description: A British investigation reveals that Mayssoun Nassar, who has taken up a senior role at the BBC, described Israelis injured by rockets as "settlers" and Beersheba as an "occupied" city.

item.title: Missing toddler found on baggage belt at Ben Gurion Airport
item.description: Two-year-old wanders off while his parents check in for a flight to Larnaca, is found unharmed on the conveyor belt.

item.title: Iran warns modified ballistic missiles could reach Britain
item.description: Iranian state television has warned that modified versions of the country's Khorramshahr ballistic missile could reach American military installations in Europe.

item.title: 18 years after terror attack | Arrest over surveillance of Mumbai Chabad House
item.description: India's counterterrorism unit arrests young man suspected of gathering information on Chabad House and Jewish institutions in Mumbai, passing it to parties outside the country.

item.description: Medline receives reports of 35 serious injuries as well as seven deaths associated with potential fire and entrapment hazards, issues updated guidance for customers.
